source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 27 May 1933, p. 7 ("Ulster elections: Kilkeel Rural Council"); Ulster Herald, 27 May 1933, p. 5
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the four divisions, names, parties and votes read from the News-Letter's 'Kilkeel Rural Council' results (27 May 1933, p. 7)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each electoral division, polled in County Down on 25 May 1933. Four divisions were contested; the News-Letter prints those four contests only, so the unopposed divisions are not listed here. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Majority 9.
